text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The stage is set for autumn, at the 'Sprinters Stakes'!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With the title of 'Fastest of Our Era' on the line! Let's settle this!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Ever since then, constantly.
Before I know it, I find myself thinking about it.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... whew...
......

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ..."Fastest of the era"――

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ('Honestly'... It was a word I'd never even thought of.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Of course, these legs, this speed, are my greatest pride and joy.
A precious treasure given to me by everyone.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(When I step up to race, of course,
no matter how fast the others are,
I go in believing my legs won't lose.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Still, even so, all this time—
I was doing everything I could just to 'repay the favor.')

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That was the only thing I aimed for.
That was the only thing on my mind.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (That's why—...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh. ...A refreshing breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Miracle-san.
Did the morning breeze beckon you out as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... Zephyr...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Are you being swayed by the winds of instigation?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, or perhaps the morning wind.
The very moment it begins, one might say.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...?
Sorry, Zephyr, what I meant just now was—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it.
Were you about to head back to the academy?
If so, I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
After this—
shall we have a light race on the grounds?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... great, looks like nobody's here yet.
We can run to our heart's content like this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the autumn breeze.
Together, with all our might, let us become the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way.
Doesn't it bring back memories, Miracle-san?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Standing together on the grounds like this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I—recall the day we met,
shining warm like a patch of sunlight."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
!
...Ah, that's right—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
When we first met, too,
we ran together on an empty track, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. You were just about to apply for transfer into the senior division—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even though it was your day off, you were invited by the breeze and came out for a run.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I was the one who asked, wasn't I?
...To please run alongside me, that is.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I was surprised, but I was also kinda thrilled, you know?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, running around the Academy track like that
in casual clothes was the first and last time for me, after all—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, I hadn't even taken the transfer exam yet,
and I'd barely just started serious training."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The last time I competed with someone with everything I had...
was in a "race."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That was my first time.
...With Zephyr, it was a first for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So to me, it was a really special memory, but... I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: You remembered too, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, always.
Even if I am swept away by the autumn gale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Because my soul called out to you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: My soul...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Crossing successive worlds, crossing time, a distant divine wind blowing from on high.
You could say I was swept along by it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san. ...I...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ever since the moment I first laid eyes on you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You are the breath of my destiny.
...Somehow, I was certain you were a gust of wind
blowing across the very same era as me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was why, back then...
—I invited you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It has been so from the very beginning.
To align with you and become the wind is so exhilarating
and joyous that it makes my soul tremble—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And more than anyone else...
it is you whom I truly want to beat.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've come to feel that only by competing with you...
can I truly master speed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...However, at the Sprinters Stakes,
that didn't come to pass, did it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Of course, your absence was like a dry gale. But in addition, I too... was far too much of a mere gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It was weak, fleeting, and utterly drowned out.
Even though I thought my body was ready...
it didn't reach even a fragment of that crimson brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —However, it's different now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (And then, Zephyr paused for a moment...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (She stared right into my eyes and nodded. So, I too...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Nodding back. ...And then...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (We started running.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The damp morning air of early summer
is sharply torn apart with a whoosh.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Lightly. Sharply. ...And fiercely.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Zephyr...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Zephyr is...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(—She was fast!!
She's gotten... even faster...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting.
For this moment, for so, so long...!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now, at last...
...At long last.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash against one another.
Our speed. Our strength. Our convictions.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle-san.
Here, I will surpass you, and reach the pinnacle of speed—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sprint, mile, medium distance.
I will become the gust of wind that conquers all three divisions.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Transcend the barrier of distance,
and be freer than anyone, anywhere.
I will show you I can become a wind that sweeps endlessly across the land.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yamanin Zephyr.
In the name of the wind god—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My soul, my raging gale.
I shall show it to you now!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, w... Whaaaaaat?!?!?
Zeph-chan?! What's what's what's going ooon?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me, or is it super... windy?
Wait, wasn't that a shock just now!?!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Please concentrate, Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise—
you will be swept away by the wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (The presence Zephyr radiates is a little... no, actually, it's pretty terrifying.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That speed I felt with my own skin. That strength.
All of it is still lingering inside me.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Is this strange? ...It is strange, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Somehow... my heart is pounding—!!)
